resources.string: Look up here
When you highlight a poster, its details appear at the top: name, episode, how long it is, and what it\'s about. You don\'t have to open it to peek.
The side menu
This column is your main menu: Home, Watchlist, Search, Movies, TV Shows, and Settings. From a poster in a row, press Left, or press Back while you\'re on Home.
Your profile
This is the account you\'re signed in as. Select it to switch to another person, so everyone keeps their own watchlist and progress.
Looking for something specific? Type its name, or use the mic button on the Search page to say it.
Your starting point. Select it from anywhere to jump back to Home. Select it while you\'re already on Home to update your rows with the newest content.
Your saved list of things to watch later. To add something, highlight its poster and hold OK, then choose to add it.
Can\'t find a movie or show? Request it here. Check back to see whether it\'s been approved and added.
Your libraries
These icons open your content by type: %1$s. Pick one to browse everything in that category.
Adjust playback, subtitles, and how the app looks. Want to see this tour again? Go to Settings → Help.
